ArticleFilter.description: JSON, URL-encoded in the filter parameter. Operators: eq, neq, in, lt, gt, contains, null. Depth up to 3, 20 conditions.

PersonFilter.description: JSON, URL-encoded in the filter parameter. Operators: eq, neq, in, lt, gt, contains, null. Depth up to 3, 20 conditions.

Variant.name: variant
Variant.description: draft needs a preview token (x-polynovea-preview header) or the content.preview scope

Fields.name: fields
Fields.description: Comma-separated field keys to return (each must be readable)

Expand.name: expand
Expand.description: Comma-separated relation paths, e.g. author,author.company (depth up to 2)

BadRequest.description: Invalid parameter, filter, sort, expansion or write body

Unauthorized.description: Invalid, expired or revoked API token

Forbidden.description: Token lacks scope, model access or a preview token

Unavailable.description: The model's table is not ready (Retry-After) or the query timed out
